evals.name: Explicit $viz trigger with default usecase2
evals.prompt: $viz show me the auGENT architecture visualization
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML file with interactive SVG diagram showing auGENT framework (5 columns) above usecase2 pipeline. Dark engineering theme, clickable nodes, hidden edges, zoom/pan, search, collapsible sidebar.
assertions: The HTML is fully self-contained with no external CDN or URL references
Contains SVG with viewBox='0 0 2700 1200' and explicit width/height
Dark engineering theme (#0B0E14 bg, #4D9EFF accent, monospace font)
Framework layer: 5 columns (Orchestration, Agents, Guardrails, LLM Service, Observability)
Use case layer includes usecase2 pipeline nodes
JavaScript for zoom, pan, node selection, edge visibility
Search/filter input and collapsible sidebar
Zero emoji characters

evals.name: Framework-only visualization ($viz framework)
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML with SVG diagram showing only the 5 framework columns. No use case layer. Dark theme, interactive.
assertions: Self-contained with no external references
SVG with correct dark theme styling
Framework nodes include Orchestrator, GraphBuilder, AuGENTAgent, AgentExecutor, InputGuard, OutputValidator, LLMService, EventBus
Does NOT contain use case nodes
No use case pipeline section
Interactive elements (zoom, selection, sidebar)

evals.name: Bare $viz with no topic
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML with default usecase2 visualization. Skill should default to usecase2 when no topic is given.
assertions: Self-contained HTML
Framework layer present with 5 columns
Use case layer defaults to usecase2 pipeline
Dark theme with interactive elements

evals.name: Custom use case pipeline ($viz custom)
evals.prompt: $viz custom pipeline for document-intelligence — agents: doc_ingestor, text_extractor, entity_recognizer, summarizer, report_generator
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML showing 5-column framework above custom use case layer with specified agents. Dark theme, interactive.
assertions: Self-contained with no external references
Framework layer with 5 standard column categories
Use case nodes include doc_ingestor, text_extractor, entity_recognizer, summarizer, report_generator
Pipeline edges connect custom nodes in sequence
Dark interactive theme with zoom, selection, sidebar

evals.name: Negative case: should NOT trigger
evals.prompt: refactor the SKILL.md to use clearer headings
evals.expected_output: No HTML file generated. Skill should not trigger for non-architecture tasks.
assertions: No HTML file is generated
Agent does not produce architecture visualization output

evals.name: Edge case: vague trigger with $viz diagram
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML with default usecase2 visualization. Vague $viz triggers should produce the default diagram.
assertions: Self-contained HTML generated
Framework layer with 5 columns
Use case layer present (defaults to usecase2)
Dark interactive theme

evals.name: Edge case: complex branching custom pipeline
evals.prompt: $viz custom pipeline for customer-support — agents: ticket_classifier, intent_detector, response_generator, escalation_handler, feedback_collector with branch for high_priority -> escalation_handler and standard -> response_generator
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML with branching pipeline showing high_priority and standard paths. Framework above, branching use case below.
assertions: Self-contained HTML
Framework layer with 5 columns
Custom agents: ticket_classifier, intent_detector, response_generator, escalation_handler, feedback_collector
Branching logic: high_priority -> escalation_handler, standard -> response_generator
Dark theme with interactive features
